description: Use when you want to compare a fund, 13F filer or ETF portfolio with a benchmark: active share and the largest active weights. Not for the subject's own holdings (use riskmodels_get_fund, riskmodels_get_filer or riskmodels_get_etf). Returns, from GET /data/benchmark-fit, active share, active-weight RMS (a coarse tracking-error proxy), overlap, and the largest over- and underweights at a common date. Benchmarks: ff_own (free-float-cap weights of the subject's own holdings), the large and small style cells (cell_large-value, cell_large-blend, cell_large-growth, cell_small-value, cell_small-blend, cell_small-growth), or all (every available benchmark for the subject). Holdings dates follow the latest filings; weights use end-of-day prices. Price: $0.02 per call.

as_of.description: Upper bound on the subject's holdings date; the benchmark is taken at its latest date on or before it, format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-03-31

benchmark.description: ff_own, a large or small style cell, or all, e.g. cell_large-growth

subject.description: BW-* portfolio id (BW-FUND-…, BW-FILER-…, BW-ETF-…) or an ETF ticker, e.g. BW-FUND-S000019457 or SPY

top.description: Number of over- and underweights, integer 1-100, e.g. 20 (default 10)

name: riskmodels_get_benchmark_fit
title: RiskModels Benchmark Fit (active weights)
